description: This file contains unit tests for key-value type classes in C++, using Google Test framework. It tests the behavior of 'KeyValueType' and 'TextKeyValueType' classes, including construction, assignment, comparison, and key access.

classes.name: KeyValueType
classes.description: A template class representing a key-value pair with comparison and key access methods.

classes.name: TextKeyValueType
classes.description: A template class for key-value pairs where keys and values are text fragments with case sensitivity options.

classes.name: TextFragment
classes.description: A class representing a fragment of text, constructed from a string.

methods.name: KeyValueType::KeyValueType
methods.description: Constructs a key-value pair with optional key and value.

methods.name: KeyValueType::operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for copying key-value pairs.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Key
methods.description: Returns the key part of the key-value pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::Value
methods.description: Returns the value part of the key-value pair.

methods.name: KeyValueType::IsKey
methods.description: Checks if the given string matches the key.

methods.name: TextKeyValueType
methods.description: Class for text-based key-value pairs with case sensitivity.

methods.name: TextFragment
methods.description: Represents a portion of text, initialized from a string.
